goal: Single pre-frozen directional BTC-leading ALT catch-up hypothesis; one-time read-only historical pilot, no alpha claim
authorization: User approved research-only simple strategy economic development; no separate issue1388 economic-heavy activation or G4 authority

source.source_market: BingX USDT-M historical 1m OHLC (previously certified transport)
source.validation: must re-aggregate from fully continuous 30 observed minutes
source.exclude: BTC is reference only; trade five non-BTC alts
source.historical_availability: BAR_CLOSE_MODEL_ONLY; network historical receive-at not verified

economics.historical_funding: not certified; current-p95 one-settlement reserve cost scenario only
economics.capital: equal-notional trade-bps, not NAV or portfolio

fixed_rule.bar_availability: signal only after complete BTC and ALT 30m close, only as of matching UTC boundary

signal.btc_trend: BTC close[t] > SMA(BTC close[t-23:t]) 24 completed bars
signal.alt_trend: ALT close[t] > SMA(ALT close[t-23:t]) 24 completed bars
signal.count: one non-repainting signal per completed 30m pair

fixed_rule.entry: buy ALT at next complete bar opening, only if flat in same ALT; no limit-order optimistic fill
fixed_rule.exit: at first stop OR 8th completed 30m bar after entry, whichever first
fixed_rule.stop: fixed stop entry_price - 1.5*ATR14_from_signal (ATR complete bars through t); if exit bar open <=stop exit at open, else if bar low<=stop exit at stop; gap adverse never discounted
fixed_rule.simultaneous_symbols: strategy-by-symbol independent cohort; no account-level portfolio assumption
fixed_rule.no_end_mark_to_market: exclude open final positions from completed trades and record censored

checks: one strategy only, one historical run no parameter grid
no lookahead, no end-bar rebasing, no gap skip
closed-bar source continuity 30 of 30 minutes each
negative result REJECT gross/cost or hold insufficient sample
positive result DEV_ONLY until independently unused OOS and exact account risk/funding/fill authority
